motion_support.completion: Nearest observed RGB extends unobserved input for still/video presentation only. Original input files, native benchmark and fitted coefficients are unchanged.
motion_support.limits: Native-grid support tests at33 shifts, not continuous/subpixel or output-scattering confidence. Completed pixels remain estimates.
motion_support.exterior_context: Exterior and refracted glass use one translating coordinate system, with completed incident RGB and any separately declared exterior layer. Missing context remains an estimate; no fixed reference strip is spliced into the moving background.

a.motion: Stationary element; recovered backdrop translates vertically. Optical/material coefficients remain frozen.
a.limits: Offline preview, not Apple motion timing, a device benchmark or proof of adaptive cross-scene material. Source footage retains its original information quality; SVG icons/font and catalogue artwork use their declared clean/high-resolution inputs. Undeclared legacy foreground coverage remains reference-derived.

video_color.limits: Encoded RGB export metadata; no measured display/transfer-function calibration.
